title: Ward 2009: pcsa of multifidus at whole (mixed, cadaver)

imaging.posture_detail: cadaver fixed in supine neutral lumbar posture

quantity.name: pcsa
quantity.definition: physiological CSA = muscle volume (mass/density) / fibre length (x cos pennation if stated)

source.authors: Ward SR, Kim CW, Eng CM, Gottschalk LJ, Tomiya A, Garfin SR, Lieber RL
source.sample: 8 cadaveric lumbar spines; formalin-fixed cadavers (T12-sacrum, fixed supine/neutral), age 84 (3) y, height 170.5 (11.1) cm, weight 81.1 (15.3) kg; plus 16 surgical patients for intraoperative biopsies

how_to_simulate: Sum the PCSA (or F_max / specific tension) of all model elements of multifidus, one side (or the named fascicle).
Compare with the cadaveric mean +/- SD; note specific tension and fibre-length normalisation used by the source.
protocol.notes: Abstract/results give mean +/- standard ERROR (stored in "se"; sd left empty).

extraction.check_notes: Abstract values re-read. Per-level values (Fig. 4) not digitised.
